head: codex/578-glm-5-3-flash-provider-profile
title: [v0.92.1][PROV] Add GLM-5.3-Flash provider profile
body:
Closes #578

## Summary
- adds general profile `z_ai:glm-5.3-flash` resolving to `hosted:adl-z-ai:glm-5.3-flash` and provider model id `glm-5.3-flash`
- updates the direct Z.ai endpoint to `https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4/chat/completions`
- materializes GLM-5.3-Flash defaults for `reasoning_effort=max`, `clear_thinking=false`, `temperature=1.0`, `top_p=0.95`, and bounded output tokens
- supports runtime overrides and rejects invalid GLM-5.3-Flash settings before network dispatch
- proves reviewer-agent selection uses the general profile rather than reviewer-only routing
- documents source rationale plus the OpenRouter/Ollama-cloud variant boundary

## Validation
- `cargo fmt --manifest-path adl/Cargo.toml --check`
- `cargo test --manifest-path adl/Cargo.toml --test provider_tests profiles::z_ai_glm_5_3_flash_profile_expands_for_reviewer_agent_selection`
- `cargo test --manifest-path adl/Cargo.toml --test provider_tests http_family::zai_glm_5_3_flash_request_materializes_profile_defaults_and_runtime_overrides`
- `cargo test --manifest-path adl/Cargo.toml --test provider_tests z_ai_glm_5_3_flash`
- `cargo test --manifest-path adl/Cargo.toml --test provider_tests zai_glm_5_3_flash`
- `bash .csdlc/prepared/issues/578/reviewer-selection-smoke.sh`
- `cargo test --manifest-path adl/Cargo.toml --test provider_tests` (66 passed, 1 credential-gated ignored)

## Review
Independent exact-head review PASS by `fresh-session:b8205d48-4329-489e-9298-4449cf0552d8` with no findings at `git-blake3:55cf30e99e3c240ceef6f140013ad7feab3135c1:cf0f9bfc8b13973bd5a07cd12304a1f8990368a02e97fa4cd236a23744764965`.

## Notes
- Live Z.ai dispatch remains credential-gated; this PR does not claim a live model call.
- OpenRouter `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash` and Ollama `glm-5.3-flash:cloud` remain separate provider routes and are not implemented here.
- The bind/prepared-helper materialization issue is captured in `.csdlc/prepared/issues/578/tooling-issue-bind-prepared-helper-materialization.md`.
